errors.text_span: five different methods—Base, MEND, FT, MEMIT, IKE, and ROME—
errors.evidence: The description states there are five methods, but the list that follows and the plot itself both show six distinct methods.
The x-axis does not start at 10⁰ (1). The first labeled tick mark is 10¹ and the data points begin at a co-occurrence number greater than 1 (around 5).
The description incorrectly identifies the markers for the MEMIT method as stars, while the plot clearly shows they are pentagons.
The description omits a detailed breakdown of the IKE method (red line with upward-pointing triangles), even though it is listed in the introductory sentence and is one of the six series in the plot.
